settings.heading: Accessibility Assistance
settings.row_content: If you have difficulty using or accessing any element of this website or on any Salsa Cycles mobile app or tool, please feel free to call us at 877-774-6213 or email us at accessibility@qbp.com and we will work with you to provide the information, item, or transaction you seek through a communication method that is accessible for you and consistent with applicable law (for example, through telephone support).

settings.heading: Accessibility for All
settings.row_content: Salsa Cycles desires to provide a positive customer experience to all our customers, and we strive to continuously enhance usability, accessibility, and inclusion on this website. Whether you are using assistive technologies like a screen reader, a magnifier, voice recognition software, or captions for videos, our goal is to make your use of Salsa’s website a successful and enjoyable experience.

settings.heading: Actions
settings.row_content: We are taking a variety of steps and devoting resources to further enhance the accessibility of our website.

settings.heading: Ongoing Effort
settings.row_content: Although we are proud of the efforts that we have completed and that are in-progress, we at Salsa Cycles view accessibility as an ongoing effort.

settings.heading: Feedback
settings.row_content: Please contact us if you have any feedback or suggestions as to how we could improve the accessibility of this website.
